purpose: Maps agent roles to AI providers. Roles are architecture; provider assignment is configuration. Change providers by editing this file only - never by editing code or prompts.
warning: This file must never contain an API key. Keys are read from the environment variables named in each provider's api_key_env field.

anthropic.notes: Model ID intentionally left null. It must be pinned to a concrete string and recorded under D-0009 before first API call, because model IDs change over time and an unpinned model makes past output unexplainable.

glm.notes: The user named GLM 5.3. The exact API model string above has NOT been verified against the provider's API and must be confirmed before first use.

BULK_RESEARCH.purpose: High-volume ingestion of transcripts, pages and papers.

KNOWLEDGE_EXTRACTION.purpose: Extract atomic candidate knowledge units from processed source content (SPEC-KNW-001). Output is CANDIDATE knowledge, UNVERIFIED by definition.

CLASSIFICATION.purpose: Assign subject, topic, subtopic and question family.

SUMMARIZATION.purpose: Condense long sources without losing provenance.

DEEP_REASONING.purpose: Derive methods, build recognition decision trees, design curricula.

CODE_REVIEW.purpose: Review code written by a different provider.

VERIFICATION.purpose: Independently check a claim produced by another provider.

ARBITRATION.purpose: Decide between two providers that disagree.

rules.self_verification_forbidden: A provider may never verify its own output. AUTO_NOT_AUTHOR resolves at runtime to any candidate provider other than the one that authored the item.
rules.arbitration_limitation: Only two providers exist, so no neutral third party is available. When both disagree, the item stays DISPUTED and is escalated to the user. Never ask a disputant to judge its own dispute.
rules.capability_is_not_evidence: A provider being strong is never a reason to skip verification.
rules.deterministic_first: If a claim is mathematical and checkable by code, it must be checked by code, not by any model in this file.
